rationale: Build on the staged reverse-tail recurrence baseline by reallocating a small amount of export budget to keep recurrent-tail V projections in fp16 during int8 roundtrip. The local best family is already quantization-sensitive in the recurrent tail, and recent close misses suggest tail float-budget rescue is still live; this targets the value path directly without changing training shapes, step structure, or wallclock behavior.
title: Recurrent Tail V FP16 Rescue Sweep
